gates.command: python3 -c "import subprocess; url=subprocess.check_output(['git','config','--get','remote.origin.url']).decode().strip(); h,p=(url[4:].split(':',1) if url.startswith('git@') else url.split('://',1)[1].split('/',1)); ident='/'.join(x for x in p.split('/') if x).removesuffix('.git').lower(); assert ident=='madventuresllc/madventures-tui', ident; print(ident)"
